svg.title: LionDriver V-cycle: legend
svg.desc: Legend: status colours, the next-gate outline and the verifies line.
svg.text: Status of each work product (one block each):
Outline: due at the next gate, G0
Dashed line: the right-hand box verifies the left-hand box
Work products are grouped by hand; their status, gates and dates are read from the records on every build, so the V moves as they change. Status is not acceptance.

g.text: Terms: AI artificial intelligence · FSC functional safety concept · G0–G6 gate G0…G6 of the project lifecycle · HARA hazard analysis and risk assessment (ISO 26262-3) · HIL hardware in the loop: the bench with the real panda and

simulated car buses · HSI hardware-software interface · HW hardware · MISRA MISRA C, the coding guideline for the C of the envelope (WP-W-01 §5) · ML machine learning · SOTIF safety of the intended functionality (ISO 21448):

hazards with nothing failing · SW software · TARA threat analysis and risk assessment (ISO/SAE 21434) · TSC technical safety concept · WP-nn work product, e.g. WP-C-04; the letter is its area (M management, C concept, S system, H
hardware, W software, V validation, P processes, A analyses, O operation, K safety case)
